input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF011",
  "title": "Single cycle actuator handshakes with one transition per scan",
  "difficulty": "hard",
  "requirements": "# SELF011: Sequential Gripper-Transfer Handshake Cycle\n\n## Background\nFive-stage pick/clamp/release/retract handshake sequence (`IDLE`, `EXTEND`, `CLAMP`, `RELEASE`, `RETRACT`, `DONE`).\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `Start`, `Stop`, `Reset`, `ExtendDone`, `ClampDone`, `ReleaseDone`, `RetractDone` (`BOOL`).\n2. If `Stop = TRUE` or `Reset = TRUE`, return immediately to `IDLE` and clear all outputs.\n3. Otherwise from `IDLE`: enter `EXTEND` iff `Start = TRUE AND RetractDone = TRUE`.\n4. Advance one step per scan on matching feedback: `EXTEND & ExtendDone -> CLAMP`; `CLAMP & ClampDone -> RELEASE`; `RELEASE & ReleaseDone -> RETRACT`; `RETRACT & RetractDone -> DONE`; `DONE` holds until `Stop`/`Reset`.\n5. Outputs match post-transition phase: `Extend`/`Clamp`/`Release`/`Retract` mirror their named state, `Busy` holds in active steps `1..4`, `Done` holds in `DONE`.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `Start: BOOL`, `Stop: BOOL`, `Reset: BOOL`, `ExtendDone: BOOL`, `ClampDone: BOOL`, `ReleaseDone: BOOL`, `RetractDone: BOOL`\n- **Outputs:** `Extend: BOOL`, `Clamp: BOOL`, `Release: BOOL`, `Retract: BOOL`, `Busy: BOOL`, `Done: BOOL`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `state=\"IDLE\"`, `all_commands=false`, `Extend=false`, `Clamp=false`, `Release=false`, `Retract=false`, `Busy=false`, `Done=false`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\nAt most one transition occurs per scan; all inputs are level-sensitive.",
  "scenario": "An assembly fixture coordinates an extending slide and a clamp using explicit completion handshakes, allowing deterministic commissioning tests.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Start",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Begin one fixture cycle"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Stop",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Abort fixture cycle"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Reset",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Clear cycle state"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "ExtendDone",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Extension completion handshake"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "ClampDone",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Clamp completion handshake"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "ReleaseDone",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Release completion handshake"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "RetractDone",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Retracted home handshake"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Extend",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Slide extend command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Clamp",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Clamp command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Release",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Release command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Retract",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Slide retract command"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Busy",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "An action state is active"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Done",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Cycle completed"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "state": "IDLE",
    "all_commands": false,
    "Extend": false,
    "Clamp": false,
    "Release": false,
    "Retract": false,
    "Busy": false,
    "Done": false
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Stop or Reset overrides all transitions",
    "At most one state transition per invocation"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Completion inputs are handshake states; no mechanical safety certification is implied.",
    "No timeout is included; an absent handshake intentionally stalls the current action.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "Start": "I[k].Start: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Stop": "I[k].Stop: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Reset": "I[k].Reset: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "ExtendDone": "I[k].ExtendDone: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "ClampDone": "I[k].ClampDone: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "ReleaseDone": "I[k].ReleaseDone: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "RetractDone": "I[k].RetractDone: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Extend": "O[k].Extend: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Clamp": "O[k].Clamp: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Release": "O[k].Release: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Retract": "O[k].Retract: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Busy": "O[k].Busy: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "Done": "O[k].Done: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "qIdle": "Spre.reference.state.mode=0",
    "qExtend": "Spre.reference.state.mode=1",
    "qClamp": "Spre.reference.state.mode=2",
    "qRelease": "Spre.reference.state.mode=3",
    "qRetract": "Spre.reference.state.mode=4",
    "qDone": "Spre.reference.state.mode=5",
    "normal": "!Stop & !Reset.",
    "oneAction": "int(O[k].Extend)+int(O[k].Clamp)+int(O[k].Release)+int(O[k].Retract)<=1",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: Spre.mode=IDLE, O_init.Extend=false, O_init.Clamp=false, O_init.Release=false, O_init.Retract=false, O_init.Busy=false, O_init.Done=false."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P1",
      "formula": "G(oneAction)",
      "explanation": "Action commands never overlap.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P2",
      "formula": "G((Stop | Reset) -> (!Busy & !Done & !Extend & !Clamp & !Release & !Retract))",
      "explanation": "Abort clears every command immediately.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P3",
      "formula": "G((normal & qIdle & Start & RetractDone) -> Extend)",
      "explanation": "Home-qualified Start enters only the first action.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P4",
      "formula": "G((normal & qExtend & ExtendDone) -> Clamp)",
      "explanation": "Extension completion enters clamp.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P5",
      "formula": "G((normal & qClamp & ClampDone) -> Release)",
      "explanation": "Clamp completion enters release.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P6",
      "formula": "G((normal & qRelease & ReleaseDone) -> Retract)",
      "explanation": "Release completion enters retract.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P7",
      "formula": "G((normal & qRetract & RetractDone) -> Done)",
      "explanation": "Home arrival completes the cycle.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P8",
      "formula": "G((normal & qDone) -> Done)",
      "explanation": "A completed cycle cannot restart without an explicit clear.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P9",
      "formula": "G((normal & qExtend & !ExtendDone) -> Extend)",
      "explanation": "The fixture waits for an extension handshake rather than assuming completion.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P10",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G((Busy <-> (Extend | Clamp | Release | Retract)) & (!(Busy & Done)))",
      "description": "Busy holds iff one of the four active stages (Extend/Clamp/Release/Retract) is active, and is mutually exclusive with Done.",
      "explanation": "Previously Busy had no positive constraint during active stages.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF011.P11",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G(((normal & qIdle & !(Start & RetractDone)) -> (!Busy & !Done)) & ((normal & qClamp & !ClampDone) -> Clamp) & ((normal & qRelease & !ReleaseDone) -> Release) & ((normal & qRetract & !RetractDone) -> Retract))",
      "description": "IDLE without Start & RetractDone stays all-off, and CLAMP/RELEASE/RETRACT hold their actuator while awaiting completion feedback.",
      "explanation": "Completes stage-hold symmetry alongside existing P9 (EXTEND hold).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
